query:
SELECT m.id, m.sponsorId, m.attendeeId, m.timeSlot, m.status,
       d.firstName, d.lastName, d.company,
       s.companyName AS sponsorCompany
FROM meetings m
JOIN delegateProfiles d ON m.attendeeId = d.id
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE d.id = '7'
ORDER BY m.id;
